Sandbox_PhunSpawn_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging for point registration, discovery and spawning
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_UseSpawnRoom_tooltip: If yes, a new character wakes up in an off grid arrival room rather than on the spawn square, so the first thirty seconds are theirs. Needs PhunInteriors; with it absent the character is placed at the point itself
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_DiscoveryRadius_toolti: How close you have to get to a spawn point before you remember it. Larger means more found by accident
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_ShowUndiscovered_toolt: If yes, places you have not found are listed greyed out, so the list is somewhere to head for. If no, they are not sent to your client at all
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_AllowBuiltPoints_toolt: If yes, a player may mark a place of their own as somewhere to wake up
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_BuiltPointLimit_toolti: How many a character may hold at once. Set to 0 for no limit
Sandbox_PhunSpawn_RespawnPenalty_tooltip: If yes, choosing where to wake up costs the new character something. Off by default
